text:
**It cannot be determined from this evidence whether forest protection rules were violated.**

The data show about 0.6 hectares of tree-cover loss on the property in 2022, of which 0.5 hectares overlapped an area mapped as native forest. But tree-cover loss does not by itself establish deforestation, its cause, or whether any activity was authorized.

A compliance determination would require checking the applicable rules, permits and the circumstances of the loss.
